    · exact hb
    · exact (hn True.intro).elim

@[simp] theorem xor_not_left : Xor (¬a) b ↔ (a ↔ b) := by
  unfold Xor
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨hna, hnb⟩ | ⟨hb, hnna⟩)
    · constructor
      · intro ha
        exact (hna ha).elim
      · intro hb'
        exact (hnb hb').elim
    · have ha : a := by
        by_cases ha : a
        · exact ha
        · exact (hnna ha).elim
      constructor
      · intro _
        exact hb
      · intro _
        exact ha
  · intro hab
    by_cases ha : a
    · by_cases hb : b
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hb, fun hna => hna ha⟩
      · exact (hb (hab.1 ha)).elim
    · by_cases hb : b
      · exact (ha (hab.2 hb)).elim
      · exact Or.inl ⟨ha, hb⟩

theorem Prop.exists_iff {p : Prop → Prop} : (∃ h, p h) ↔ p False ∨ p True :=
  ⟨fun ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ ↦ by_cases (fun H : h₁ ↦ .inr <| by simpa only [H] using h₂)
    (fun H ↦ .inl <| by simpa only [H] using h₂), fun h ↦ h.elim (.intro _) (.intro _)⟩
overrides.replacement:
theorem Prop.exists_iff {p : Prop → Prop} : (∃ h, p h) ↔ p False ∨ p True := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    by_cases H : h1
    · have heq : h1 = True := propext ⟨fun _ => True.intro, fun _ => H⟩
      rw [heq] at h2
      exact Or.inr h2
    · have heq : h1 = False := propext ⟨fun h => (H h).elim, False.elim⟩
      rw [heq] at h2
      exact Or.inl h2
  · rintro (h | h)
    · exact ⟨False, h⟩
    · exact ⟨True, h⟩

theorem Prop.forall_iff {p : Prop → Prop} : (∀ h, p h) ↔ p False ∧ p True :=
  ⟨fun H ↦ ⟨H _, H _⟩, fun ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ h ↦ by by_cases H : h <;> simpa only [H]⟩
overrides.replacement:
theorem Prop.forall_iff {p : Prop → Prop} : (∀ h, p h) ↔ p False ∧ p True := by
  constructor
  · intro H
    exact ⟨H False, H True⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩ h
    by_cases H : h
    · have heq : h = True := propext ⟨fun _ => True.intro, fun _ => H⟩
      rw [heq]
      exact h2
    · have heq : h = False := propext ⟨fun h' => (H h').elim, False.elim⟩
      rw [heq]
      exact h1

theorem dite_ne_left_iff : dite P (fun _ ↦ a) B ≠ a ↔ ∃ h, a ≠ B h := by
  by_cases hp : P
  · rw [dif_pos hp]
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact False.elim (h rfl)
    · rintro ⟨hnp, _⟩
      exact (hnp hp).elim

    constructor
    · intro h
      exact ⟨hp, fun hab => h hab.symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨_, h⟩
      exact fun hab => h hab.symm

    (x y : α) (z : β) : f (if P then x else y) z = if P then f x z else f y z := by grind

     if q : Q then B q else if p : P then A p else C p q := by

theorem Function.Injective.ite {α β : Sort*} {p : β → Prop} [DecidablePred p] {g : β → α}
    (hg : g.Injective) {f : β → α} (hf : f.Injective) (h : ∀ x y, g x = f y → x = y) :
    (fun x ↦ if p x then g x else f x).Injective :=
  fun x y _ ↦ by rcases em (p x) with (hx | hx) <;> rcases em (p y) with (hy | hy) <;> grind
overrides.replacement:
theorem Function.Injective.ite {α β : Sort*} {p : β → Prop} [DecidablePred p] {g : β → α}
    (hg : g.Injective) {f : β → α} (hf : f.Injective) (h : ∀ x y, g x = f y → x = y) :
    (fun x ↦ if p x then g x else f x).Injective := by
  intro x y hxy
  change (if p x then g x else f x) = (if p y then g y else f y) at hxy
  by_cases hx : p x
  · by_cases hy : p y
    · rw [if_pos hx, if_pos hy] at hxy
      exact hg hxy
    · rw [if_pos hx, if_neg hy] at hxy
      exact h x y hxy
  · by_cases hy : p y
    · rw [if_neg hx, if_pos hy] at hxy
      exact (h y x hxy.symm).symm
    · rw [if_neg hx, if_neg hy] at hxy
      exact hf hxy
